models_evaluated: AutoML Edge model in Android app (Google Firebase)

links.outcome: Performance of the deployed AutoML edge model on an external dataset versus internal test results
links.effect: On the external dataset via the app, AuPRC was 0.875, sensitivity 83%, specificity 81%, accuracy 83%, versus internal TF AuPRC 0.945, sensitivity 87%, specificity 88%, accuracy 88%.
links.quote: Through the Android app and using an external dataset, the AutoML model had an AuPRC of 0.875, sensitivity of 83%, specificity of 81%, and accuracy of 83%.

unlisted_practices: Using code-free AutoML so clinicians without coding experience can build diagnostic models
Deploying edge AI models in offline smartphone apps for field diagnosis

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility and accuracy of clinician-built AutoML models deployed on an edge smartphone application using external validation datasets, but does not test a specific deployment guardrail or organizational practice.
